release_notes: KLAM 3.7.4 production release rebuilt, installed and functionally tested successfully. Finance Expense Entry was enhanced to support multi-category batch entry while maintaining separate Vendor/Payee and Note information for each expense transaction. Income and Expense categories now display in alphabetical order for easier entry and navigation. Expense entry layout and Note visibility were refined and verified. Controlled Opening Balance Reverse/Reset functionality was tested successfully, including creation of the reversing journal, preservation of the original journal audit history, reset of opening amounts to 0.00, and reopening of USD Opening Balances for correct entry. Existing church data and AppData remained intact after installation. Core modules, navigation, reports, backup, transfer/merge centres, Help & Training, DPA masking and background notifier behavior were verified. KLAM 3.7.4 is approved as the new production baseline.
